thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call @sophia — High latency alert for /v1/stream (streaming tail). p95 jumped to ~1.2s -> 3.8s, p99 ~6s; multiple SLO breaches in the last 3m. Auto-escalation to sev2.
sophia: on it, joining. any customer impact reported yet?
devin: seeing large tail in the streaming pipeline, looks like tokenizer/preproc time spiked. graphs: https://dashboards.internal/r/streaming/tail — p95 tokenization time from 40ms -> 1.4s for some shards.
maria: support says a handful of customers reported timeouts for streaming sessions, one enterprise flow retried and hit rate limits. Support case IDs: SUP-4122, SUP-4129.
sophia: ok priority: 1) mitigate customer-facing impact 2) find root cause. quick wins?
henry: can we route traffic to fallback model variant (quantized) and keep streaming semantics? that would reduce tokenization path cost.
aj: fallback routing ready but needs canary config change in service-router; I can flip if oncall approves.
sophia: do it, start with 10% then 50. post rollback if any errors.
aj: flipping 10% now.
deploy-bot: routing-config: updated service-router (canary=10%) — change id cfg-8923.
devin: small dataset of affected requests — all have JSON mode enabled and heavy tool schemas embedded in prompt templates (large schema blocks per request). tokenizer time grows with schema size; streaming stalls while waiting for template preproc.
maria: that matches support notes — customers using tool-calls + JSON mode.
sophia: can we disable JSON-mode validation at runtime as stopgap? feature flag exists: feature:json-mode-validate.
henry: yes we can toggle to false, but that will change how we surface parse errors. acceptable for short window.
sophia: toggle now.
aj: toggling feature:json-mode-validate -> false across region us-west-2.
incident-bot: feature flag change recorded by ops-bot (evt-5519).
devin: quick check after toggle: tokenization p95 dropped to ~480ms on canary traffic, p99 still high but trending down.
maria: customers on canary reported improvement for some flows.
sophia: good. next: identify root cause permanently. attach logs for a single hung stream: 
```[stream-id=abc123] preproc.start template_len=14230 tool_schema_len=10892 json_mode=true
[stream-id=abc123] tokenizer_ms=3820 kvcache_wait_ms=12 model_queue_ms=5
[stream-id=abc123] preproc.complete errors=0
```
henry: that clearly shows preproc/tokenizer dominated. looks like our prompt-renderer is inlining full tool schemas into templates rather than referencing. that's new since the tool-schema-expansion change last week (PR #3145).
devin: confirmed — PR #3145 expanded tool schemas inline to support offline evals; it increased median template size for tool-calls by ~4x. regression test missed streaming tail case.
sophia: action items: revert or patch PR #3145, add template size guardrails, add streaming-only fast-path to skip schema inlining. who owns PR?
henry: eng-ml owns it; devin working on hotfix.
devin: opening hotfix PR now to add opt-out for streaming requests (PR #3278). will try to get a patch + canary in 30m.
aj: if patch deploy risks breaking other flows, we can continue routing more traffic to fallback model and keep JSON validation off until fixed.
maria: notify affected customers with status update: "We identified a preproc regression; mitigation in progress, partial improvement seen after feature toggle. We'll follow up with timeline."
sophia: agree. Maria please post to customers.
maria: posted to SUP cases and status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2065432100
aj: increasing canary to 50% to reduce user impact.
deploy-bot: routing-config: updated service-router (canary=50%) — change id cfg-8924.
devin: hotfix PR #3278 submitted, running CI. Key change: short-circuit schema inlining when header `x-streaming-fastpath=true`.
sophia: plan for quick deploy: merge on green, canary 10% to hotfix, monitor 15m, then promote.
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #3278.
aj: deploying hotfix canary now (deploy-9002).
deploy-bot: deploy 9002 started -> canary (10%).
devin: monitoring tokenization p95 on hotfix shards: dropped to ~120ms — huge improvement. p99 also falling.
henry: great, keep an eye on streaming stalled sessions metric.
maria: support: customers on canary reporting restored connectivity and no timeouts.
sophia: after 15m stable, promote to 100%.
aj: promoting.
deploy-bot: deploy 9002 promoted to 100% — change id deploy-9002.
incident-bot: SLOs recalculated: p95 now 110ms, p99 320ms, all SLOs back within target. incident downgraded to sev3.
sophia: handing off to henry for follow-up (root cause + permanent guards). I'll update oncall log.
henry: will open a follow-up ticket with remediation checklist: revert inlining for streaming, add preproc template size alert, add unit/regression tests, and review PR #3145. ETA EOD tomorrow. ticket: INF-7620.
maria: I'll send final customer communications and postmortem link when ready.
sophia: thanks team. final notes: temporary measures taken: feature:json-mode-validate=false, routing canary to fallback during mitigation, hotfix PR #3278 short-circuited schema expansion for streaming. root cause: tool-schema inlining regression from PR #3145 that inflated template sizes and caused tokenizer/preproc tail latency.
henry: adding owners + timeline to INF-7620.
sophia: closing oncall handoff, tagging henry as owner. good job. :thumbsup:
support: closing related support cases and linking to status update.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (downgraded to monitoring). Logs and timeline archived under incident/2065432100.
